# Parse, Don't Pray: The Case for Data Validation

This is the well-known discovery copy for agentic assistants.

Canonical slides: https://www.indrapatil.com/parse-dont-pray/
Root llms.txt: https://www.indrapatil.com/parse-dont-pray/llms.txt
Root llms-full.txt: https://www.indrapatil.com/parse-dont-pray/llms-full.txt
Source: https://github.com/IndrajeetPatil/parse-dont-pray/

Summary: Explore the benefits of Pydantic and Zod for runtime validation, type safety, focused contract testing, and safer input boundaries. The deck uses current Pydantic 2.13 and Zod 4.5 APIs, covers measured validation optimization, and distinguishes validation from authorization and transport-level protections.
